function.name: get_sheet_info
function.description: Describe the active sheet and used range. Without focus, preview at most the first 5 rows and 6 columns. With focus, return row-one headers and a small addressed neighborhood around that range.

focus.description: A1 cell or range to preview.

function.name: aggregate_cells
function.description: Calculate a range statistic locally on the active sheet. Returns a number without changing cells or sending all values. For a result to insert, write a formula.

function.name: find_cells
function.description: Find literal text inside displayed cell values on the active sheet, case-insensitive. Returns up to 12 matching addresses with previews in row order. Pass next_after as after for the next page.

after.description: Continue strictly after this cell address.

function.name: read_cells
function.description: Read a range in A1 notation (at most 2000 cells). Returns calculated values row by row, plus the formulas and number formats of cells that have them. Long text can be read in windows. next_starts gives the next offset for each incomplete address.

function.name: set_cells
function.description: Write values or formulas. values is a list of rows written from the top-left cell of range. A string starting with = is a formula; an empty string clears the cell. If values is a single cell and range covers several cells, it is filled into all of them and relative references in a formula are adjusted for each cell, like fill down.

range.description: Top-left cell or target range, for example D2 or D2:D10.

function.name: insert_rows
function.description: Insert empty rows before row number row (1-based). Cells below move down; formulas are adjusted.

function.name: insert_columns
function.description: Insert empty columns before column letter column. Cells to the right move right; formulas are adjusted.

function.name: delete_rows
function.description: Delete rows starting at row number row (1-based). Cells below move up; formulas are adjusted.

function.name: delete_columns
function.description: Delete columns starting at column letter column. Cells to the right move left; formulas are adjusted.

function.name: set_number_format
function.description: Set the number format of a range using an Excel format code, for example 0.00, #,##0, 0%, 0.0%, yyyy-mm-dd, or General to reset. Values are not changed.

function.name: sort_range
function.description: Sort whole rows of a range by one column. Rows keep their cells together; formulas move with their rows.

range.description: The full table range, for example A1:D20.

by_column.description: Column letter of the sort key.

has_header.description: true if the first row of range is a header that stays in place.
